_about: Seats and vote thresholds for a bill like H. 3861 in the South Carolina General Assembly. Batch 2026-11-e ledger rows in brackets. The spec computes the thresholds from the seat totals; nothing on the page is typed from here by hand.

after.note: leader in each of the 124 contests, SC Election Commission report 12:00 a.m. Nov. 4, 2026; unofficial

recount.note: margins 0.23 and 0.70 points; S.C. Code 7-17-280 requires a recount at 1% or less

senate.note: not on the 2026 ballot except one special race

rules.quorum: a majority of each house (SC Const. Art. III, Sec. 11)
rules.passage: three readings on three days in each house (Art. III, Sec. 18); in the House a tie fails (House Rule 1.6)
rules.override: two-thirds of each house after a veto (Art. IV, Sec. 21)
